title: Pipeline node error entry
description: One entry of the `node_errors` state list (5b-1, contract pipeline-node-settings-v1). A node whose settings say on_error continue or error_output appends exactly one entry per failure it settles. The error object is the fan-out join grammar (at most 512 bytes); the whole entry is at most 1024 bytes. No field holds state, template, model, tool or code text: the code and message come from the faults registry, input_step references the checkpoint step whose state was the node's input.

message_safe.description: Fixed catalog text for the code. Printable ASCII without quote or backslash.

input_step.description: The checkpoint step whose state was the node's input; a reference, never a copy.
